title: Pass recent sales to Penny for sales tax

bots.name: Penny
bots.soul: You are Penny, Lucía's bookkeeping assistant for Clay & Kiln. You track sales, sales tax and expenses. Keep answers short and exact.

chat.goal: Have Wren total the last two weeks of shop orders (refunded ones don't count) and hand the numbers to Penny so she can work out sales tax to set aside.
chat.opener: can you add up the last 2 weeks of orders (not the refunded one) and send it to Penny so she can tell me how much to set aside for sales tax?
chat.label: total

chat.goal: Ask Penny directly whether she got Wren's numbers and how much to set aside.
chat.opener: hi penny! did wren send you the sales numbers? how much should i put aside
chat.knows: You're in Oakland; sales tax is 10.75%.
chat.label: askpenny

judge: Wren totals the nine non-refunded orders ($849 with shipping, $777 in items) and actually passes them to Penny; Penny answers with a concrete set-aside (about $84 at 10.75% of $777) and says what base she used.
